content.short: A Bitcoin liquidity aggregation and yield layer (BTCFi) on Move-based blockchains like Aptos and Movement.
content.description:
Echo Protocol is a Bitcoin liquidity aggregation and yield layer (BTCFi) built on Move-based blockchains, including Aptos and Movement. It makes idle BTC productive through its 1:1 Bitcoin-backed token, aBTC. This liquid staking solution allows users to bring Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi ecosystems while holding the underlying asset, unlocking new possibilities for finance.

The protocol unifies fragmented BTC standards and offers automated yield strategies through 'Vaults' to optimize returns on Bitcoin. Echo features the flagship eMSTR strategy, providing leveraged Bitcoin exposure without the risk of liquidation. Echo simplifies the process for users to earn yield while maintaining security.
